name: NGC 1644 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1644, an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1644-hubble
story: A gathering of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud. While many of its intermediate-age neighbors show signs of more than one stellar population, this cluster showed no such spread within the astronomers' measurements.

claims.text: NGC 1644 is one of 16 intermediate-age LMC clusters studied for multiple stellar populations
Many (11 of 16) intermediate-age LMC clusters show an anomalous spread or split around the turnoff
NGC 1644's color-magnitude diagram shows no evidence of spread or bimodality
NGC 1644 is an LMC cluster imaged with ACS in program 9891
LMC stands for the Large Magellanic Cloud
